question.text: The Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS) is suitable for which stage of retirement?

answer.text: Distribution stage for regular monthly income

explanation.text: The Logic: POMIS is designed for the distribution stage — it provides fixed monthly income from a government-guaranteed scheme. It is ideal for meeting regular monthly expenses in retirement. The Trap: POMIS is not suitable for accumulation (no compounding option) or tax planning (no 80C benefit). Its strength is regular, reliable monthly income. Cross-Exam Context: POMIS as a distribution product is tested in Series XVII. Compare with SWP from MFs which offers flexibility but no guarantee.
